flash fire: You gain 100% fire absorption. The first time you would take fire damage in a combat, you gain +3 fire damage for the remainder of combat.
weak armour: Whenever you take melee damage, you gain -3 melee resistance and +4 damage for the remainder of combat.
protosynthesis: In sunlight, you gain +1 to all attack rolls and ability checks governed by your highest ability score(s).
intimidate: On initiative, choose a creature within 60' of you to gain -3 melee damage for the remainder of combat.
moxie: On Killing Blow, gain +3 melee damage for the remainder of combat.
sharpen: All bludgeoning damage you would deal is converted to piercing and increased by 1.
lightning rod: You gain immunity to lightning damage. Whenever you would take lightning damage, gain +3 ranged/area damage for the remainder of combat.
power drive: You gain immunity to lightning damage. Whenever you would take lightning damage, you gain +2 damage for the remainder of combat.
blade sipper: You gain immunity to slashing damage. Whenever you would take slashing damage, you gain +3 melee damage for the remainder of combat.
dark rush: While outdoors and not in sunlight, gain +4 damage.
dark force: While outdoors and not in sunlight, gain +2 bludgeoning, slashing, and thunder damage.
mould breaker: You cannot be affected by the major effects of foes.
competitive: Whenever a condition is applied to you by a foe, gain +6 ranged/area damage for the remainder of combat.
healer: At the end of each of your turns, remove a random negative condition from a random ally who has one.
illuminate: You gain immunity to the blinded condition.
natural cure: At the end of each combat, all conditions are removed from you.
analytic: You have +3 damage while at the bottom of the initiative tracker.
strong jaw: All of your unarmed attacks become bite-related and deal +3 damage.
dark body: While outdoors and not in sunlight, gain +2 passive regen.
sturdy: Damage cannot reduce you below 1 HP if you were healthy before taking the damage.
armour mastery: While your armour is 5+ or you are holding a shield, you gain +1 to all attack rolls and ability checks governed by your highest ability score(s).
tangled feet: While you are confused, all attacks against you have disadvantage.
co-star: Whenever you roll for initiative, you may copy all on-initiative effects of your choice from an ally also rolling for initiative.
overcoat: You gain immunity to non-falling environmental damage, unless it would deal more damage than your maximum hit points.
chaos guard: Whenever you would take damage, you have a 50% chance to be immune to it and a 50% chance to be 50% vulnerable to it.
expertise: On killing blow, gain +1 to all attack rolls and ability checks governed by your highest ability score(s) for the remainder of combat.
sheer force: Your major successs do not trigger major effects, but deal +3 damage.
desperate control: While bloodied, you have -21 melee damage, +18 ranged/area damage, and +6 resistance.
rock head: You gain immunity to damage during your turn, and ignore all raw HP loss caused by yourself.
adapt: You gain +3 melee damage vs targets with higher will than armour, and +3 ranged/area damage against all other creatures.
thick fat: You gain 50% resistance to fire and cold.
guts: While you have a condition applied to you by a foe, you have +3 melee damage. Additionally, your melee damage is not reduced by the debilitated condition.
water bubble: You gain 50% resistance to fire and +6 bludgeoning damage. Additionally, you gain immunity to ongoing fire harm.
suction cups: You cannot be moved against your will.
bludgeoning drain: You gain immunity to bludgeoning damage, and all bludgeoning damage taken by allies within 60' of you from attacks is redirected to you (major successes ignore immunity as usual). Whenever you would usually take bludgeoning damage, you gain +3 ranged/area damage for the remainder of combat.
dark cloak: While outdoors and not in sunlight, gain +1 to all defences.
anticipation: Whenever you roll for initiative, you learn all immunities of each foe within 60' of you.
dire reflection: Whenever a creature would inflict a condition on you, that creature gets the condition instead of you.
defiant: Whenever a condition is applied to you by a foe, gain +6 melee damage for the remainder of combat.
supreme overlord: You gain +3 melee damage while at least one ally within 60' is down.
pressure: Whenever a creature attacks you, that attack is disabled for the remainder of combat, or until it targets you with another attack.
comatose: You are always unconscious. While unconscious, you are not incapacitated, can move and speak, and can sense your surroundings, but remain persistently prone while on the ground. Additionally, you gain immunity to all conditions other than unconscious and prone.
own tempo: You gain immunity to the confused and frightened conditions.
dark recovery: While outdoors and not in sunlight, you are cured of all conditions at the end of each of your turns.
shell armour: You take no bonus damage from critical successs.
skill link: Your ability score modifiers are doubled for the purposes of being added to your damage.
damp: Foes within 60 feet of you cannot trigger effects when they reach 0 HP, and cannot reduce their own HP.
cloud nine: While outdoors, you always count as being in sunlight.
telepathy: You are immune to damage dealt by your allies.
unnerve: Foes in combat with you have +1 strife.
steadfast: Whenever your concentration is broken, gain +2 damage for the remainder of combat.
insomnia: You are immune to the unconscious condition while your HP is above 0.
keen eye: Your attack rolls cannot have disadvantage.
poison point: When hit by a melee attack, the attacker becomes poisoned for the remainder of combat.
swarming frenzy: While bloodied, you gain +3 piercing damage.
damage boost: At the end of each of your turns, gain +2 damage for the remainder of combat.
quick feet: While you have a condition applied to you by a foe, you have +2 damage.
frisk: Whenever you roll for initiative, choose a creature within 60' of you of which to learn all of its passive traits.
harvest: Every day you travel within a journey, make a save. On a success, gain 1 Supply.
levitate: You are always hovering 1 foot off the ground.
inner focus: You can never lose concentration against your will. Additionally, you automatically succeed on insight checks against intimidation.
infiltrator: Your attacks ignore half and three quarters cover.
delta stream: You radiate a 60' aura of strong winds. You and allies within this area have +2 resistance while airborne.
water veil: You are immune to ongoing fire harm.
reckless: Your powers that cause you to lose HP deal +3 damage and remove 1 more HP.
soundproof: You are immune to the deafened condition and thunder damage.
justified: Whenever you take necrotic damage, you gain +3 melee damage for the remainder of combat.
iron fist: All of your unarmed attacks become fist-related and deal +3 damage.
fluffy: You gain +3 melee resistance and -6 fire resistance.
klutz: You cannot hold items other than brawling weapons. Additionally, you deal +6 damage with brawling weapons.
synchronise: Whenever a creature would inflict a condition on you, that creature also gets the condition.
electric surge: You and allies within 60' of you that are standing on the ground gain +3 resistance.
battle armour: Attacks cannot score critical successes against you, and instead just score major successes.
cursed body: Whenever you are hit by an attack, that attack cannot be used again by the attacker for the remainder of combat, or until you disable a different attack with this passive.
noisy: You gain +3 thunder damage and 50% resistance to thunder damage.
polar: If an ally within 60' has this crystal passive, you gain +3 ranged/area damage.
technician: Your basic weapon attacks and cantrips deal +3 damage.
filter: Damage against you cannot be increased.
lingering aroma: Whenever you are hit by a melee attack, the a random one of the attacker's passive traits is removed for the remainder of combat.
haemophilic: You count as bloodied while below 75% of your maximum HP.
aroma veil: Your powers can never be disabled.
rivalry: You deal +2 damage vs creatures of the same type as you, and -2 damage against others.
receiver: Whenever an ally within 60' of you drops to 0 HP, replace this crystal passive with the ally's crystal passive (if they have one) for the remainder of combat.
blaze: While bloodied, you gain +3 fire damage.
white steam: You are immune to the weakened and brittle conditions.
drought: You radiate a 60' aura of sunlight. You and allies within this area have +2 damage.
vital spirit: Foes cannot inflict the unconscious condition on you.
nullifier: All creatures within 60' of you have their immunities nullified.
ice face: The first melee attack against you each combat has its success tier reduced by 1. This effect recharges whenever you end your turn hidden from all foes.
regenerator: Whenever combat ends, you recover 3 HP.
flame body: Whenever you are hit by a melee attack, the attacker suffers 1 ongoing fire harm, stacking until it passes a passive save.
clear body: Your damage cannot be reduced and damage against you cannot be increased.
ripen: Gold you lose from journey activities is halved.
overgrow: While bloodied, you gain +3 slashing damage.
leaf guard: While you are in sunlight, you are immune to all conditions.
contrary: Whenever your damage would be reduced or damage you take would be increased, it is instead increased or reduced, respectively, by the same amount.
wonder skin: You have +1 to all defences against non-damaging attacks.
